concept: stick person leaping a small creek
layout_notes: left_ground pad occupies the left third, right_ground pad the right third, empty water gap in the middle. Action arcs from left pad up over the gap and down onto the right pad, peak roughly at the middle of the frame.

parts.name: jumper_head
parts.notes: same size on every key, travels with the body

parts.name: jumper_torso
parts.notes: short and crouched at start, tucked diagonal in air, upright at land

parts.name: jumper_left_arm
parts.notes: swings back in crouch, raised forward in air, forward at landing

parts.name: jumper_right_arm
parts.notes: mirrors left arm, pumps up during flight

parts.name: jumper_left_leg
parts.notes: deeply bent in crouch, tucked knee-up in air, extended on landing

parts.name: jumper_right_leg
parts.notes: deeply bent in crouch, tucked under in air, extended on landing

parts.name: left_ground
parts.notes: left bank pad, identical points every key

parts.name: right_ground
parts.notes: right bank pad, identical points every key

parts.name: water_surface
parts.how: two or three short dashes in the gap
parts.notes: marks the creek between pads, never moves

keys.name: start
keys.notes: deep crouch, knees bent, arms swung back behind hips, head low over left_ground, weight loaded for launch

keys.name: air
keys.notes: topology key: feet fully off both pads, body at peak of arc above the water dashes, knees tucked up, arms reaching forward, head high and midway between the two pads

keys.name: end
keys.notes: topology key: feet contact right_ground, slight landing crouch to absorb impact, arms forward for balance, head above right pad
